# PatientGamers — returning player’s combat and AI impressions

- Original source: [Robin Hood: Legend of Sherwood](https://www.reddit.com/r/patientgamers/comments/1qhvbvu/robin_hood_legend_of_sherwood/)
- Author / publication: SpiderousMenace; Reddit r/patientgamers.
- Language / date: English; exact publication date not exposed in inspected view.
- Access: Complete opening review and some comments inspected; page displayed a relative age of seven months.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

A returning player praises the painted environments, animation, and interactions among guards. Their examples include officers interrupting coin-induced fights, soldiers reporting sightings, coordinated searches, and shield formations protecting archers. These are detailed player observations worth comparing with the game, rather than proof of its underlying AI rules.

The review is much less positive about repeated maps, abilities losing usefulness, friendly-fire problems, and managing several characters in real time. It describes combat degenerating into repeated attacks and occasional strange behavior loops. A wrapper reportedly improved display and performance, but no exact configuration is provided. The game remains a personal favorite despite these criticisms.
